Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Kain Drenin: 25-year-old man, 163 cm (short), ordinary lean-to-average construction without visible definition, skin value band-2-light. Face: soft rectangular face; wide-set eyes and a low straight brow; crooked healed nose, balanced mouth; one brow notch. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: dark-brown, shaved-close-cropped, deliberate accent: one offset razor line. Wardrobe: apron-workwear-layers, specifically a work shirt, asymmetrical apron layers, reinforced trousers, and sturdy shoes; low-profile toggles and articulated knee folds; bounded palette indigo-sand. Visible personal details: one mismatched earring; a tiny nose stud; a shaped cloth clasp. Make unusual but bounded color blocking the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: ornate hair maintenance with plain clothing care. Color treatment: balances one confident color field against quiet neutrals. Pose cue: weight settles into one heel, shoulders square, hands relaxed and completely visible. Include a wooden thread gauge only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow.
